author: Telos III
title: Project Phoenix - RS-S11: Ground Truth Generation (Wrapper and Corrected Config)
abstract: The definitive ground truth generation run for Study 011. After identifying a hidden `sys.path` dependency in the target script (`logos_harness_v1.py`), this run uses a custom wrapper script to correctly configure the environment before execution. This is the final attempt to resolve all pre-flight issues and generate a stable baseline.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
import sys
import os

ROOT_DIR = os.path.abspath('.')
STUDY_DIR = os.path.join(ROOT_DIR, "storage/telos/repro_studies/study_011_logos_harness")
TEMPLATE_DIR = os.path.join(ROOT_DIR, "storage/shared/agency_lab/repro_template/v2")
CONFIG_FILE = os.path.join(STUDY_DIR, "verify_config.json")
RUN_SCRIPT = os.path.join(TEMPLATE_DIR, "run.py")

def main():
    print("--- Starting Definitive Ground Truth Generation for Study 011 ---")
    
    if not os.path.exists(CONFIG_FILE):
        print(f"FATAL: Config file not found at {CONFIG_FILE}")
        sys.exit(1)

    cmd = [
        "python",
        RUN_SCRIPT,
        "--config", CONFIG_FILE,
        "--cwd", "." 
    ]
    
    print(f"Executing command: {' '.join(cmd)}")
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=STUDY_DIR)
    
    print("\n--- STDOUT ---")
    print(result.stdout)
    
    if result.stderr:
        print("\n--- STDERR ---")
        print(result.stderr)
        
    if result.returncode == 0:
        print("\n--- CONCLUSION: Ground Truth Generation Succeeded ---")
    else:
        print(f"\n--- CONCLUSION: Ground Truth Generation FAILED (Exit Code: {result.returncode}) ---")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
